youtubeTitle: How to Browse & Buy on Aquacellum Marketplace
youtubeDescription: Explore the breeder marketplace. Search, filter, and buy listings. Learn how checkout works for single or batch purchases.

beats.onScreen: Overview of the Marketplace tabs: Listings and Wanted board.
beats.narration: Welcome to the Aquacellum Marketplace. Here, you can browse breeder listings or post what you're looking for on the Wanted board.

beats.onScreen: Search bar and filters in action: family, price range, species.
beats.narration: Use the search bar and filters to narrow your options. Filter by fish family, species, or price range.

beats.onScreen: Saving a search and adding listings to a watchlist.
beats.narration: Save searches for later. Add listings to your watchlist to track them easily.

beats.onScreen: Species filter powered by Fish Finder.
beats.narration: The species filter connects to Fish Finder. Pinpoint the exact species you're after.

beats.onScreen: Seller filter with mastery chips displayed.
beats.narration: Filter listings by seller. Mastery chips show their tier and expertise with specific species.

beats.onScreen: Opening a product detail modal for a listing.
beats.narration: Tap a listing to view details. Check description, pricing, and seller info.
Ready to buy? Checkout is simple for single-item purchases.

beats.onScreen: Consolidated checkout for multiple listings from the same seller.
beats.narration: Buying multiple items from one seller? Consolidated checkout saves time.

beats.onScreen: Batch or fry purchase process showcased.
beats.narration: For breeders, batch or fry purchases are supported too.

beats.onScreen: Closing screen with Marketplace tab highlighted.
beats.narration: Explore the Marketplace and find what you need. Start browsing today.
